summary: This document describes requirements for a BGP security protocol design. The design should give cryptographic assurance that an origin AS has the right to announce a prefix, and assurance of the AS path in the announcement.

eli5.summary: BGP is how networks tell each other which roads lead where, but anyone can lie. This RFC lists what a secure version needs so you can check who may announce a route and the path it took.

questions: how to secure bgp as path
